title: Ankhorage Neon Infrastructure
summary: Implements the Neon control-plane adapter for provider-neutral Ankhorage database infrastructure.
purpose: Provision and reconcile Neon project resources while keeping database application runtime ownership separate.
responsibilities: Own Neon project, branch, database and role control-plane lifecycle through the canonical Infra adapter contract.
boundaries: Does not own provider-neutral database contracts or application persistence behavior.
Does not provide a Neon-specific SQL runtime adapter.
audience: Infrastructure maintainers evaluating or introducing Neon-hosted PostgreSQL resources.

architecture.role: Provider adapter package for Neon-hosted PostgreSQL infrastructure.
invariants: Resolved Neon credentials never enter generated outputs, diagnostics or public package APIs.

limitations: Live Neon operations require an explicit control-plane credential reference and are not run by default.
